SELECT A.BND_TTL, A.JEMOK, A.RC_CODE, Z.RC_RFILE_NO, Z.RC_RITEM_NO, B.ORG_FILE_PATH, B.ORG_FILE_NAME, B.SAVE_FILE_NAME, Z.FILE_NAME, NULL AS CONTENTS, Z.INDEXING_CONTENTS, Z.ZIP_SEQ, Z.ZIP_ENTRY_FILE_NAME, Z.FILE_TYPE, Z.FILE_GUBUN FROM EXTRACT_ELEC_DOC Z JOIN CN_ELEC_DOC B ON B.RC_RFILE_NO = Z.RC_RFILE_NO AND B.RC_RITEM_NO = Z.RC_RITEM_NO AND B.SAVE_FILE_NAME = Z.FILE_NAME AND B.TRANSFERYEAR = #{transferYear} JOIN CN_RITEM A ON A.RC_RFILE_NO = Z.RC_RFILE_NO AND A.RC_RITEM_NO = Z.RC_RITEM_NO WHERE Z.EXTRACT_STATUS = 'PASS' AND Z.HAS_CONTENTS = 'Y' AND Z.INDEXING_CONTENTS IS NOT NULL AND Z.INDEXING_CONTENTS != ''
AND (Z.LLM_SUMMARY_STATUS IS NULL OR Z.LLM_SUMMARY_STATUS != 'PASS')
AND Z.SUMMARY_FLAG IS NULL AND Z.LLM_SUMMARY_STATUS IS NULL
ORDER BY Z.RC_RFILE_NO, Z.RC_RITEM_NO, Z.FILE_NAME, Z.ZIP_SEQ LIMIT #{limit}
